commons.name: Commons
commons.description: Guess the Master's secret word correctly using yes/no questions, and identify the Con Artist!

conArtist.name: Con Artist
conArtist.description: Stop the members of the Commons from guessing the Master's secret word without giving yourself away!

master.name: Master
master.description: Answer yes/no questions to help the group guess your secret word, and identify the Con Artist!

tracker.name: Tracker
tracker.description: Help the members of the Commons guess the Master's secret word without giving yourself away!

roleInfo.name: Member
roleInfo.description: You are a member of the Commons. Guess the Master's secret word correctly using yes/no questions, and identify the Con Artist!

roleInfo.name: Master
roleInfo.description: You are told a secret word at the start of the round. All other players try to guess your secret word by asking yes/no questions. If the word is guessed correctly, identify the Con Artist!

roleInfo.name: Tracker
roleInfo.description: Help the members of the Commons guess the Master's secret word without giving yourself away!

roleInfo.name: Con Artist
roleInfo.description: Stop the members of the Commons from guessing the Master's secret word without giving yourself away!

Default.inAMomentTell: ($1) - in a moment, tell me whether you want Ludio to teach your group how to play this game!
Default.whoNeedsTheTutorial: ($1), who needs the tutorial? Click on the players or select from the middle.
Default.everyoneElseIsA: Everyone else is a Member of the Commons.
Default.thisRoundYouAre: This round, you are a Member!
Default.shhhhMembersGetA: Shhhh ... Members get a similar announcement telling them they're Members.
Default.thisRoundYouAre2: This round, you are the Con Artist!
Default.thisRoundYouAre3: This round, you are the Tracker!
Default.theMasterTrackerAnd: The Master, Tracker, and Con Artist...
Default.theGoalOfThe:
The goal of the Con Artist is to make sure the group does NOT guess the word.
The goal of the Tracker is to make sure the group DOES guess the word.
However, if either of them fail to achieve their goal, they can still win by guessing who had the secret role on the opposite team.
Default.ifTheSecretWord: ... if the secret word is “water” and the group correctly guesses within 5 minutes that the word is “water”, the Con Artist can still win by identifying who the Tracker is.
Default.clickTheGuessedButton: Click the GUESSED button as soon as someone correctly guesses the secret word!
Default.theGroupHas5: The group has 5 MINUTES to guess the word by asking the Master yes/no questions! If the word is not guessed, everyone loses.
Default.theyWillNowAttempt: They will now attempt to guess the Tracker.
Default.whoDoYouThink: ($1), who do you think the Tracker is?
Default.whoDoYouThink2: Who do you think the Con Artist is? The vote ends when the majority of players vote at one player.
Default.wouldYouLikeTo: Would you like to play again?
